interest: U.S. sailors rescue Japanese sailors at Nanking, 1933.
overview: Peck's 1933 despatch: an American sampan rescued three Japanese sailors at Nanking; Japan thanked the Sacramento.

subfiles.about: Consular report on the rescue of three Japanese sailors from the gunboat Sumida by a motor sampan of the U.S.S. Sacramento after an accidental capsizing at Nanking.
subfiles.from: Willys R. Peck, American Consul General, Nanking, China
subfiles.summary: Peck reports the Sacramento's sampan rescued three Japanese sailors from the Sumida; three others drowned.
subfiles.title: Despatch No. 577 from Willys R. Peck on Rescue of Japanese Liberty Party by U.S.S. Sacramento Motor Sampan
